policy: REFERENCE LIBRARY ONLY, NOT A RANKING OR HEADLINE PRIORITY CONFIG. Previous P0/P1 labels and calendar frequencies were assistant-introduced, not approved editorial priorities, and have been removed. Use when a major global event requires a specific official technical or government source. GIB six-section frozen contract controls editorial output.
